name: TryAMM Heirs & Legacy Kids
purpose: Help families document knowledge, ownership, education, digital assets, business continuity and succession pathways for heirs without replacing legal estate planning.
principles: documented consent and guardianship where needed
clear distinction between education, beneficial interests and legal title
modules: password/key recovery planning without exposing secrets
minorSafety: no public display of sensitive family wealth data
parent/guardian consent and regional legal review
criticalGuardrails: do not store raw private keys or passwords in plain text
do not represent succession records as a will or trust
legal transfer requires valid external legal instruments
verify identity and authority before access changes
protect minors and sensitive financial information
